'''Tie:''' {{legend0|#D2B1D9|40–50%}} {{legend0|#808080|No votes}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Mike DeWine]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Mike DeWine]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsOH}} The '''2000 United States Senate election in Ohio''' took place on November 7, 2000. Republican incumbent [[Mike DeWine]] was re-elected to a second term over [[Ted Celeste]]. DeWine was the first Republican re-elected to the Senate from Ohio since [[John W. Bricker]] in [[1952 United States Senate election in Ohio|1952]]. This was the last time until the [[2024 United States Senate election in Ohio]] that Republicans won Ohio’s Class 1 Senate seat. == Republican primary == === Candidates === * [[Frank Cremeans]],
